subject_required: None mandatory, but Computing, CS or Maths considered for lower offer
additional_conditions: Applicants with A level Computing, Computer Science or Mathematics will be considered for a lower offer.
document_text: A level entry at Lancaster requires AAB. No specific subject is mandatory but applicants with A level Computing, Computer Science or Mathematics will be considered for a lower offer. GCSE Maths minimum 6/B and English minimum 4/C required.
Access to HE Diploma entry at Lancaster requires 36 Level 3 credits at Distinction plus 9 Level 3 credits at Merit. GCSE Maths minimum 6/B and English minimum 4/C required.

headline_grade: Accepted in place of one A level
subject_required: Subject requirements must still be met
additional_conditions: Accepted in place of one A level or equivalent qualification as long as subject requirements are met.
document_text: Lancaster accepts the Advanced Skills Baccalaureate Wales in place of one A level or equivalent qualification, as long as any subject requirements are met. GCSE Maths minimum 6/B and English minimum 4/C required.
BTEC Extended Diploma entry at Lancaster requires DDD. GCSE Maths minimum 6/B and English minimum 4/C required.

qualification_type: BTEC in combination with A levels
headline_grade: A level B + BTEC DD, or A levels AB + BTEC D
subject_required: None mandatory, but Computing, CS or Maths considered for lower offer
additional_conditions: Applicants with A level Computing, Computer Science or Mathematics will be considered for a lower offer.
document_text: BTEC in combination with A levels at Lancaster requires either A level grade B plus BTEC DD, or A levels AB plus BTEC D. Applicants with A level Computing, Computer Science or Mathematics will be considered for a lower offer. GCSE Maths minimum 6/B and English minimum 4/C required.

headline_grade: 35 points with 16 from best 3 HL subjects
subject_required: None mandatory, but HL Maths or CS considered for lower offer
additional_conditions: Applicants with HL Mathematics or Computer Science will be considered for a lower offer.
document_text: IB entry at Lancaster requires 35 points overall with 16 points from the best 3 HL subjects. Applicants with HL Mathematics or Computer Science will be considered for a lower offer. GCSE Maths minimum 6/B and English minimum 4/C required.

subject_required: Advanced Higher required where A level subject is specified
additional_conditions: Where a specific subject is required at A level, an Advanced Higher in that subject is typically required. Combination of Highers and Advanced Highers in separate subjects may be considered. Contact Admissions team for more information.
document_text: Scottish entry at Lancaster is considered on the basis of five Highers. Where a specific subject is required at A level, an Advanced Higher in that subject is typically required. A combination of Highers and Advanced Highers in separate subjects may be considered. Contact the Admissions team for more information. GCSE Maths minimum 6/B and English minimum 4/C required.
T level entry at Lancaster requires Distinction overall. GCSE Maths minimum 6/B and English minimum 4/C required.

headline_grade: Up to 3 grades below standard offer
additional_conditions: Widening participation criteria considered. No separate application needed. Applies to all undergraduate courses except Medicine.
document_text: Lancaster contextual offer applies to all undergraduate courses except MBChB Medicine and Surgery. Students who meet widening participation criteria may receive up to 3 grades below the standard offer. There is no separate application process - Lancaster reviews circumstances as part of the standard application.

additional_conditions: Available to Year 12 and Year 13 students. Must successfully complete the programme to qualify for lower offer.
document_text: The Lancaster Access Programme is available to Year 12 and Year 13 students and offers activities and experiences to develop skills for university study. Students who successfully complete the programme are typically eligible for a lower offer when applying to Lancaster University.

additional_conditions: Separate contextual scheme for Medicine. Must meet two or more widening participation criteria. Gateway Year route also available.
document_text: MBChB Medicine and Surgery has a separate contextual offer scheme at Lancaster. Applicants who meet two or more widening participation criteria may be eligible for a contextually lowered offer. A Gateway Year route is also available for those with potential who may not otherwise have had the opportunity to study Medicine.
